senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be curved, bent, crooked; to curve &c.,] to pervert, do wrong.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:8">Yoma III, 8</cite> <he>עָוִיתִי פשעתי וכ׳</he> I have done wrong, I have transgressed &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:2">Ib. VI, 2</cite> <he>עָווּ פשעו וכ׳</he> thy people Israel has done wrong &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Chullin 60b:10">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="P00808"><he>עַוִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 2:23">Deut. II, 23</cite>) <he>שעִיוּוּ את מקומן</he> Ar. a. Rashi (ed. <he>שעִיוְּתוּ</he>) they laid waste their home (deserted it); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 809">Yalk. Deut. 809</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 22:8">Yalk. Josh. 22</cite> <he>שעִוּוּ</he>.

senses.gloss: to curve one’s self (like a serpent, v. עִוְיָא), wriggle. Ib. שעיוו לאלוהות הרבה Ar. they wriggled before many deities (ed. שאִיוּוּ, v. אָוָה I).
